places.name: Bethlehem
places.prompt: Where was Jesus born?
places.text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem: because he was of the house and family of David,
places.note: Joseph goes up from Nazareth in Galilee to Bethlehem, the city of David.
places.caveat: The pin marks the Church of the Nativity, built over the traditional birthplace.

places.name: Nazareth
places.prompt: Where did the angel Gabriel appear to Mary?
places.text: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth,
places.note: The angel Gabriel is sent to Nazareth, a city of Galilee.
places.caveat: Two churches in Nazareth claim the site of the Annunciation. The pin marks the Catholic Basilica of the Annunciation.

places.name: Jerusalem, the Temple
places.prompt: Where was the child Jesus presented to the Lord?
places.text: And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses, were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord:
places.note: Mary and Joseph carry the child to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord.
places.caveat: The pin marks the Temple Mount, where the Temple stood.

places.name: Bethany beyond the Jordan
places.prompt: Where was John baptizing, beyond the Jordan?
places.text: These things were done in Bethania, beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
places.note: John is baptizing at Bethany, beyond the Jordan.
places.caveat: Al-Maghtas (Bethany Beyond the Jordan) is the traditional site. Qasr al-Yahud, on the western bank, is also venerated.

places.name: Cana of Galilee
places.prompt: Where did Jesus turn water into wine?
places.text: And the third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee: and the mother of Jesus was there.
places.note: A marriage takes place in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus is there.
places.caveat: Kafr Kanna is the town Christians traditionally associate with Cana.

places.name: Capernaum
places.prompt: Where did Jesus teach in the synagogue on the sabbath?
places.text: And they entered into Capharnaum, and forthwith upon the sabbath days going into the synagogue, he taught them.
places.note: They enter Capernaum, and on the sabbath Jesus teaches in the synagogue.

places.name: The Mount of Beatitudes
places.prompt: Where did Jesus go up a mountain and teach his disciples?
places.text: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain, and when he was set down, his disciples came unto him.
places.note: Seeing the multitudes, Jesus goes up into a mountain, and his disciples come to him.
places.caveat: The Mount of Beatitudes is the traditional site of the Sermon on the Mount.

places.name: Mount Tabor
places.prompt: Where did Peter, James and John see Jesus transfigured?
places.text: And after six days Jesus taketh unto him Peter and James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart:
places.note: Jesus takes Peter, James and John up into a high mountain apart.
places.caveat: Mount Tabor is one of the mountains identified as the site of the Transfiguration. The Gospel says only "a high mountain".

places.name: Caesarea Philippi
places.prompt: Where did Peter confess that Jesus is the Christ?
places.text: And Jesus came into the quarters of Caesarea Philippi: and he asked his disciples, saying: Whom do men say that the Son of man is?
places.note: Jesus comes into the region of Caesarea Philippi and asks who men say he is.
places.caveat: Caesarea Philippi stood at Banias, at the foot of Mount Hermon.

places.name: Jericho
places.prompt: Which city was Jesus walking through when he met Zacchaeus?
places.text: And entering in, he walked through Jericho.
places.note: Jesus enters Jericho and walks through it.

places.name: Bethany
places.prompt: Where did Jesus raise Lazarus from the dead?
places.text: Now there was a certain man sick, named Lazarus, of Bethania, of the town of Mary and Martha her sister.
places.note: Lazarus, who is sick, is from Bethany, the town of Mary and Martha.
places.caveat: Bethany is called al-Eizariya today. The Tomb of Lazarus there is the traditional site.

places.name: Gethsemane
places.prompt: Where did Jesus pray in agony on the night before he died?
places.text: Then Jesus came with them into a country place which is called Gethsemani; and he said to his disciples: Sit you here, till I go yonder and pray.
places.note: Jesus comes with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane to pray.
places.caveat: Gethsemane lies at the foot of the Mount of Olives.

places.name: Calvary
places.prompt: Where was Jesus crucified?
places.text: And bearing his own cross, he went forth to that place which is called Calvary, but in Hebrew Golgotha.
places.note: Jesus carries his own cross to the place called Calvary, in Hebrew Golgotha.
places.caveat: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre contains the traditional sites of Calvary and the empty tomb.

places.name: Jacob's Well
places.prompt: Where did Jesus meet the Samaritan woman at the well?
places.text: He cometh therefore to a city of Samaria, which is called Sichar, near the land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph. Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well. It was about the sixth hour.
places.note: Jesus, wearied with his journey, sits at Jacob's well near the Samaritan city of Sichar.
places.caveat: Jacob's Well is inside a church in Balata, near Nablus.

places.name: Mount Carmel
places.prompt: Where did Elijah meet the prophets of Baal?
places.text: Achab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered together the prophets unto mount Carmel.
places.note: Ahab sends to all Israel and gathers the prophets at Mount Carmel.

places.name: Hebron
places.prompt: Where did Abraham bury Sarah in the double cave?
places.text: And so Abraham buried Sara his wife, in a double cave of the field, that looked towards Mambre, this is Hebron in the land of Chanaan.
places.note: Abraham buries Sarah in the double cave near Mamre, that is Hebron.
places.caveat: The pin marks the Cave of the Patriarchs, the traditional burial place.

places.name: Beersheba
places.prompt: Where did Abraham plant a grove and call upon the name of the Lord, the eternal God?
places.text: And Abimelech, and Phicol the general of his army arose and returned to the land of the Palestines. But Abraham planted a grove in Bersabee, and there called upon the name of the Lord God eternal.
places.note: Abraham plants a grove at Beersheba and calls upon the name of the Lord, the eternal God.

places.name: Bethel
places.prompt: Where did Jacob dream of a ladder reaching to heaven?
places.text: And he called the name of the city Bethel, which before was called Luza.
places.note: Jacob names the city Bethel, which was called Luz before.
places.caveat: Bethel is identified with the village of Beitin.

places.name: The Valley of Elah
places.prompt: In which valley did the army of Saul face the Philistines, where David met Goliath?
places.text: And Saul and the children of Israel being gathered together came to the valley of Terebinth, and they set the army in array to fight against the Philistines.
places.note: Saul and the Israelites gather in the valley of Terebinth and set their army in array against the Philistines.
places.caveat: The valley of Terebinth is the Valley of Elah.

places.name: Joppa
places.prompt: From which port did Jonah sail to flee from the Lord?
places.text: And Jonas rose up to flee into Tharsis from the face of the Lord, and he went down to Joppe, and found a ship going to Tharsis: and he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them to Tharsis from the face of the Lord.
places.note: Jonah rises to flee from the Lord and goes down to Joppa, where he finds a ship.
places.caveat: Joppa is today Jaffa, the old port of Tel Aviv-Yafo.

places.name: Mount Nebo
places.prompt: From which mountain did Moses see the Promised Land?
places.text: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab upon mount Nebo, to the top of Phasga over against Jericho: and the Lord shewed him all the land of Galaad as far as Dan.
places.note: Moses goes up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, and the Lord shows him the land.

places.name: Nain
places.prompt: Where did Jesus raise the widow's son?
places.text: And it came to pass afterwards, that he went into a city that is called Naim; and there went with him his disciples, and a great multitude.
places.note: Jesus goes into a city called Nain, with his disciples and a great multitude.
places.caveat: Nain is identified with the village of Nein.
